title: Rauno Freiberg: homepage as a sideways row of poster cards
note: A horizontal row of white cards on #ededed: an intro card ('Rauno Freiberg is an Estonian interaction designer working with Vercel and Devouring Details') with a big yellow circle behind the words, then cards with huge cropped Helvetica words ('DD', 'Craft', 'Proj…'), a pixel hand cursor and handwritten 'Rauno's Field Notes', each opening a section. Tiny labels sit above each card. Worth reusing: sections as posters you scroll past, so the index is the visual.
